messages.subject: ggplot not working in shiny
parts:
Hi everyone-
I am trying to plot this SIR function according to user-inputted variables. The program runs and the sliders show up, but I can't figure out how to get the plot to display. The issue seems to be with the ggplot command. I included both the UI and server components below. Any help would be appreciated, thanks!!!


library(shiny)
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("Vaccination Modeling"),
  
    sidebarPanel(
    sliderInput(inputId="p",
                label="Vaccination Rate",
                value=0.1, min=0, max=1),
    sliderInput(inputId="S",
                 label="Initial Susceptible Population",
                 value=500, min=0, max=1000, step=10),
    sliderInput(inputId="I",
                 label="Initial Infected Population",
                 value=200, min=0, max=1000, step=10),
    sliderInput(inputId="R",
                label="Initial Recovered Population",
                value=300, min=0, max=1000, step=10),
    sliderInput(inputId="beta", 
                label="Transmission Rate",
                value=0.001, min=0, max=0.2, step=0.00001),
    sliderInput(inputId="gamma",
                label="Recovery Rate",
                value=0.1, min=0, max=1, step=0.05),
    sliderInput(inputId="mu", 
                label="Combined Birth/Death Rate",
                value=0.0001, min=0, max=1, step=0.00005),
    sliderInput(inputId="time",
                label="Time",
                value=50, min=1, max=100, step=1)
    ),

mainPanel(
  plotOutput("vacPlot")
  )
))


library(shiny)
library(deSolve)
library(ggplot2)

shinyServer(function(input, output){
  
  solveSirvac<-function(pars, times=tout){
  sirvac <- function(time, init, pars) {
    with(as.list(c(init, pars)), {
      dS <- ((1-p)*mu*(S+I+R))-(beta * S * I)-(mu*S)
      dI <- beta * S * I - ((gamma+mu) * I)
      dR <- (gamma * I)-(mu*R)+(p*mu*(S+I+R))
      
      return(list(c(dS, dI, dR)))
    }
    )
  }
  init<-c(S=input$S, I=input$I, R=input$R)
  return(ode(y= init, times = times, func = sirvac, parms = pars))
  }

  output$vacPlot<-renderPlot(function(){
  tout <- seq(0, time=input$time, by = 1)
  guess_pars<-c(beta=input$beta, gamma=input$gamma, mu=input$mu, p=input$p)
  guess<-as.data.frame(solveSirvac(guess_pars, tout))

  print(ggplot(as.data.frame(guess), aes(x=time, y=N, color=s))+geom_line())
 
  })

})

parts:
Oh, I see. This part:

renderPlot(function(){

Should just be:

renderPlot({

Also you are saying y=N but neither that, nor s, appear to be part of the data frame.

Also no need to call as.data.frame on both of those lines.
